caption: Fastmail inbox right after signup: the welcome panel says the free trial ends in 30 days.
Basic plan card on the monthly view: €4 per month for 1 user and 5 GB, access only through Fastmail's own apps, and no snooze, scheduled send or support for your own domain.

Checkout for Individual on the monthly term: €6 due today including €1.04 VAT. The subscription starts today, renews automatically, and there are no refunds for unused time. No card details were entered.
Clicking New user opens a phone verification step, and the same text says a mobile number is needed to send your first message; the account address is hidden.
Privacy & Security, API tokens on the trial account, with a New API token button. We did not create a token.
Export page under Settings, Migration: Download all contacts. The vCard file it gave us left out both groups we had assigned to each contact.
After reimporting the edited vCard: four contacts, each test contact listed twice, because the import added copies with new IDs instead of updating the originals.
